title: GPU picker Gen speed: our own Klein 9B benchmarks for the cards RunPod never measured
description: RunPod's best-gpu-for-comfyui table (Jul-Sep 2026) has no L4, A6000, 6000 Ada, 4000 Ada, A4500 or PRO 5000, so those picker tiles show no Gen speed bar. Replicated RunPod's setup on our own Pods (FLUX.2 Klein 9B bf16, official 4-step graph, 1024x1024, ComfyUI v0.39.0, median of repeat runs timed on the Pod, a new prompt each image) and calibrated on two cards RunPod did measure: A40 4.6 s vs their 4.80, A5000 6.75 s vs their 6.46. Add the new rows to GPU_GEN_SECS (js/data/runpodGpuSpecs.js), marked as ours, and update the picker note + docs/runpod-remote-engine.md. Harness kept outside the repo (session scratchpad, bench-klein.mjs). Spend cap $3, Fabio 2026-10-09.
